sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: In dorsal view the frontal region is dark and glossy, grading from iron orange to orange-yellow at the vertex; the edge of the postclypeus is white; the anterior part of the mandibles is black, reddish brown on the raised areas; in lateral view the head is dark iron orange, becoming orange towards the genal region; in ventral view the postmentum is chestnut brown with a white anterior margin. Eye spots distinct and colourless. Pronotum transparent with sclerotized margins. Antennal segments 1–3 darker. Head nearly square, sides slightly constricted, posterior margin rounded. Frontal region broad and long, about 2/5 of the head length to the postclypeus; narrow and concave in the middle, slightly convex in lateral view with a few wavy undulations, inclined about 50° near the postclypeus. Labrum short, nearly square. Antennal sockets prominent, segment 3 relatively long and sclerotized, antennae 11-segmented. Anterior part of the postmentum very broad. Pronotum about as wide as the head, anterior margin concave. Mandibles stout, curved inward about 45–50°. Measurements: head length including the mandibles 2.65–3.35, including the frontal horn 1.10–2.25; width of the frontal process 0.90–1.25; outer distance between the genal angles 1.20–1.55; maximum head width 1.15–1.60, height without the postmentum 1.00–1.50; pronotum maximum width 1.20–1.65, maximum length 0.70–0.95; left mandible length 1.00–1.10; body length 6.80–8.80.
